notes: Azure Commercial assurance must be explicitly selected and evidenced (e.g., FedRAMP Moderate/High where applicable, SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.).
Do not assume FedRAMP inheritance in Commercial; inheritance claims must reference the specific compliance package applicable to the customer’s tenant/region/services.
Provider compliance artifacts are typically accessed via Microsoft Service Trust Portal (STP) under appropriate terms.
evidence_sources: Microsoft Service Trust Portal (STP) compliance reports (SOC/ISO/FedRAMP where applicable)
Service-specific compliance scope statements for in-scope Azure services

notes: In IaaS, Microsoft is responsible for physical datacenter + host infrastructure; customer is responsible for guest OS hardening/patching, identity configuration, data protection, application configuration, and governance.

gating_requirements: Users authenticate via Entra ID (not local-only identities)
MFA enforced for privileged access; ideally for all users in scope
Conditional Access policies configured for the boundary
notes: Customer remains responsible for correct tenant configuration and identity lifecycle processes.

gating_requirements: Defender plan enabled for relevant subscription/resources
Recommendations/alerts are reviewed with an operational process
notes: Reduces evidence burden but does not replace governance controls.

gating_requirements: Logs from in-scope resources are collected into a workspace
Alerting rules configured for key events
Workloads actually use Key Vault for keys/secrets
Access policies/RBAC are locked down and audited
Restore testing performed on a cadence
Traffic is routed through Azure Firewall (effective enforcement point)
ExpressRoute circuit provisioned and used for the boundary connectivity
NSGs attached to subnets/NICs in scope
Default-deny inbound and restricted egress as applicable

provider_inheritance: STP compliance reports relevant to the selected assurance target (SOC/ISO/FedRAMP where applicable)
Service scope statements showing included Azure services and boundary responsibilities
customer_configuration: Tenant/subscription configuration exports (policy assignments, CA policies, Defender plans)
Architectural diagram showing boundary + enforcement points
Procedures (log review, vuln mgmt, backup restore tests)
